viz_dirs_C: visualize the vector field for a single image from camera origin using dirs_C tensor and poses
viz_dirs_W: visualize the vector field in world coordinates for a batch of images using origins and dirs_W tensors
pose2axes: convert a rotation matrix to x, y, z axis vectors using scipy Rotation
plotCameras: plot camera matrices with RGB-colored axis quivers on a 3D matplotlib axis
viz_ray_samples: visualize ray sample point clouds in 3D space alongside camera poses
